subject.title: fix(irc): chunk PRIVMSG on UTF-16 boundary to avoid lone surrogates

question: Should maintainers merge this focused UTF-16 splitter fix now and require https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99138 to rebase around it, or pause for one combined IRC chunker change?
rationale: Both PRs touch the same IRC `sendPrivmsg` loop and message-delivery semantics; the patch is correct, but final sequencing is a maintainer merge-risk choice.

options.title: Merge This Focused Fix

options.title: Pause For Combined Chunker Work
